m.x: I'm Arbiter Gerie, from the Grand Sanctum.
May the God of Grace watch over you.
Arbiter?
Do Arbiters need to punish heretics?
No.
Arbiters don't punish heretics; it's the Grace that wish to purify them...
To cleanse the filth with divine agony~
That's... That's terrifying.
Great ==SEX12==, a question for you. What are your thoughts on pain?
Do I need to have thoughts on it?
Hmm... The less of it, the better, I think.
You have a point.
But I believe only pain and suffering can lead to salvation.
Huh?
Is that true? The price of this salvation is a bit too heavy.
It's a heavy burden I must bear.
Hey there, Great ==SEX12==.
Hello!
So, have you been enjoying your life today? ;)
What a random question.
Ah, such devotion.
That counts as devotion?
Of course.
Only an honest heart can glimpse the truth of Grace.
Glimpse? Only glimpse?
We aren't meant to fully comprehend the ultimate Grace.
And what if I try?
Grace forgives our little tests ;)
Hmm...
Great ==SEX12==, I'm bleeding!
Where are you hurt?
It's ... it's oozing...
I can feel ... the wound pulsing...
Not enough! Not nearly enough!!!
My faith shines brilliantly in this overflowing blood!!!
? Are you alright?
I got my finger cut
This is the kiss of Grace! I shall offer this pain and blood as a sacrifice!!!
Don't you understand?
This is the sweetest spot on the path to salvation!
Grace is watching me NOW!!! I shall be ELEVATED!!!
?? Even if it's a small wound, please bandage it quickly!
I must refuse!
I will follow this road, for pain is the torch in the darkest night...!!!
??? I'm getting one of the others to come help you.
No... Please don't...
How can this pain be shared with anyone else...
Please, don't worry about me... I will attend to it myself...
Please avoid getting injured in the future! And absolutely do not toy with your wounds!
"Embrace all pain while you're still young."
What do you think of that, Great ==SEX12==?
I don't think so.
If you start looking for suffering now
you'll probably still have endless suffering later on.
Oh, is that how it works?
Understood. I'll go savor some suffering at once ;)
Huh?
That's not what it means!
It's supposed to be about spiritual hardship
not physical pain.
So it's encouraging you to build resilience and temper your will...
I see...
Well then, Great ==SEX12==
care to come and temper my soul?
I can take it ;)
Great ==SEX12==! Great ==SEX12==!
Where are you?
What is it?
The God of Grace hasn't looked upon me for a long time.
You mean you haven't felt pain recently? That's great news!
But I haven't felt alive in ages!
I can't stand it any longer!!
But you told me I mustn't hurt myself!!!
Therefore, you must take responsibility!!!!
Please pull the rope!! I need it now!!!
Um... I'll head to the sanctuary right now...
Mmm~ a little harder, please~
Ah~ that's... that's right~
...It’s still not enough... I’m developing a kink for this...
Hey! I'm still on the way!
Great ==SEX12==~ please don't stop!
Something deeper than faith is surging through my veins...
Is it you, Great ==SEX12==? Don't leave me...
Just hold on! I'll be right there!
Great ==SEX12==, I've been pondering something lately.
What is it?
This might sound a bit abrupt, so my apologies.
It's fine. Go ahead.
If you were to pass away suddenly one day, could you have me handle the funeral arrangements?
Leaving aside the "suddenly pass away" part...
how exactly would I contact you after I'm dead?
Ahaha...
Right. I suppose I didn't think that through.
I get where you're coming from, Gerie.
But for now, I plan on staying in the world of the living.
For a very, very long time.
So if you want to be there for my final moments
you'll have to live that long too!
Okay, I...
I'll do my best!
But to make it up to you...
If you ever need me
I'm yours, whenever and wherever.
You really are too kind.
This world is so ugly, yet you remain untouched by it.
May the blessings of Grace protect you.
Great ==SEX12==?
Oh!
It's your birthday today!
I never used to care much about this day.
But since that accident, I've really come to understand what it means to be alive. So now, I cherish it.
Whoa, hold on!
Let's not get all serious on your birthday.
Hehe...
You're right.
In that case... Will you spend the day with me? ;)
Of course.
I'm on my way.
I'll be praying while I wait.
For me, and for you.
Am I asking for too much grace, perhaps?
Not at all!
All grace has its purpose!
Next time we go to the Monolith, if we need to go deeper, let me take point.
And if we have to retreat, I'll cover our backs.
Huh?
Why?
It's my duty to mend the wounds of this world.
And it's my responsibility to keep everyone safe.
Hmm...
I can't let you do that.
Please, don't worry about me. I can handle it.
That's not what I mean.
Strategy is key in battle. Everyone has a role to play, and we have to stick to it.
Similarly, getting hurt isn't just about one person.
Even if you aren't afraid of the pain, that kind of worry spreads through the whole team.
Just because you say you're okay doesn't mean we'll just stand by and watch you get hurt.
Ah.
Your compassion shines just as brightly as it did that day.
Huh?
May the blessings of Grace protect you.
And keep your blade sharp.
Is that me on the Disc?

b.x: That must be who I was back then.

m.x: Back then, I must have been shattered into pieces...
But the God of Grace looked right past me.
The gates to Underworld were closed to me. I was rejected.
So I picked myself back up. My pilgrimage isn't over yet.
Uhh
Isn't that a good thing, though?
I suppose it is...
I've forgotten all the suffering I went through.
Now, I wander in search of salvation.
Whoa... That's deep...
Occasionally, deep within the Monolith, I will encounter dying Trekkers
Some of them are gravely wounded from fighting Stellaroids
Others have undergone severe mutations after lingering there too long
Either way, they will never be able to leave the Monolith
In them, I see death
Yet I would not call it a tragic sight. Their pilgrimage of suffering has reached its end
In times like that...
Yes, the proper thing to do is to grant them the coup de grâce
At the moment they draw their last breath
The pain or madness vanishes completely from their face
All that remains is a kind of loneliness that I don't recognize
You really are a good observer...
Heretics always flee in panic when they see me
Why are they unwilling to raise their weapons to defend their wicked beliefs?
Is it because they feel powerless facing the verdict of Grace?
Um...
I don't think that's the case...
Then what?
I think they're simply afraid of you
Well, true enough
Their feeble convictions can't sustain them in a fight to the death
From the moment they turned their backs on Grace, weakness and hypocrisy were branded into them forever
When judgment descends, all they can do is scatter in fear
Gerie, you and your power are incomparable
Do you remember our earlier conversation? The one about pain and suffering?
What about it?
Please don't do anything dangerous...
Heh, thank you for your concern.
I only meant to discuss it as an idea
I used to think that...
Even though Grace made me suffer, it also knew I wasn't beyond redemption
If I could simply endure it, sooner or later, I shall be once again redeemed
And now?
Any pain that cannot lead one to transcendence is endured in vain
That's a fair point!
Boss, today an elderly woman came to the sanctum to confide in me
Her husband passed away not long ago, and she is still in mourning
Oh...
That kind of loss is truly hard for one to accept
Indeed, there is very little we can do
We can never truly feel another's grief of lost family
We can do little except for offering some comforting words
If someday, you were to go before me...
What a heavy burden that would be for me
STOP STOP STOP
Why are you talking about me dying again?
O God of Grace, if I am found sinful, then let the miraculous one guide my path
Yet on this pilgrimage, I cannot see a future where the two of us reach the end side-by-side
If I am destined to be alone at the last, is this encounter a miracle—or simply another divine punishment?
Gerie, wake up
Are you okay?
My apologies, Boss. I guess I lost it again
Boss, when my magic energy is at its peak
I would keep recalling fragments from the past
Like what?
The creaking ropes of a swing
The heavy wooden doors of the sanctum

b.x: Though most of them have grown blurry
Even though you've forgotten most of it

m.x: Still, the most important fragments remain buried in your consciousness
And they can be awakened by magic
I see
Yet those fragments seem slightly different each time
Because memory is a living thing. It keeps changing
Forgotten details are replaced by things that never really happened
I see
I remember, the first time I went to see the Chief Justice...
The novices gripped my hands tight; I thought my judgment had finally come
She pushed the door open a crack, and a scent like the fireworks from the Snowish Festival drifted out
The Chief Justice spoke of miracles and absolution
I was terrified, but in the end, I was taken in
It was clearly a good thing, yet whenever I recall it, I still feel uneasy
The past always feels unbearable to me
What you can't bear is only your memories and imagination
Perhaps you were too lonely as a child and didn't have friends by your side
True, true
Boss, my magic almost went out of control again just now
What happened? Are you okay?
Don't worry. I've calmed down already
In that moment, I could feel the energy surging through my veins
Then, a searing heat and a wave of pain began to consume my entire being
Fortunately, I injected the sedative in time
It's good that nothing happened...
My mind is at its clearest after the magic fades
The searing pain cleanses my soul once more
Is this, too, a part of Grace?
I don't think so...
You don't?
Great ==SEX12==
I don't want injections anymore. What I want is love.
